description: Use official cuRoboV2-Fast plan_grasp with at most the configured grasp_goalset_size ranked candidates per request. Approach, grasp and Lift use the detached grasp-planning robot and open-gripper model. Check closure separately. Validate the robot, selected-target contact links, environment, peer arm and self-collision. Remove numerically rejected candidates and continue within the frozen pool. Stop at the first fully validated grasp. Attachment is created by verify_grasp after Lift and target-held confirmation. Command checking stops at a proven invalid chunk and requires complete checking for success. GraspGen TCP +Z is prefiltered to the world +X forward / -Z downward sector with a configurable lateral angle limit, default 30 degrees. Grasp Lift follows world +Z for 150 mm. Numerical endpoint orientation and sampled Lift FK checks enforce these constraints before execution. Unknown-object candidates already use the selected arm front TCP with zero additional insertion. Preserve endpoint +Z forward/downward sector and actual robot contact, closure, environment and self-collision checks.
capability: Use official cuRoboV2-Fast plan_grasp on the current candidate goalset from actual current robot joints
